verdict.rationale: The docs show both install scopes exist. The upgrade skill "detects global vs vendored install" (gstack-docs-7), and the host docs state that "project-local setup never silently replaces a global install" (gstack-docs-49). A community comment corroborates the git-clone-and-copy install model (gstack-comm-2). However, the evidence only implies the choice; it does not document how to make it. Missing for 10: explicit install docs showing how to pick project-local vs global scope, confirmation that vendored files are meant to be committed with the repo, and hands-on corroboration of both modes.
